destinations.name: Sydney
destinations.summary: Sail-like shells on Bennelong Point in Sydney Harbour.
destinations.story: Designed by the Danish architect Jørn Utzon, the Sydney Opera House opened in 1973. Its white tiled shells rise at the edge of Sydney Harbour and house multiple performance venues. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

stamp.alt: Stamp illustration of the white sail-shaped shells of the Sydney Opera House on a blue harbour.

destinations.name: Uluru
destinations.summary: A giant sandstone monolith in Australia's Red Centre.
destinations.story: Uluru rises about 348 metres above the desert plain in the Northern Territory and is sacred to the Anangu, its Traditional Owners. The rock appears to change colour from ochre to deep red at sunrise and sunset. Climbing was permanently closed in 2019 out of respect for Anangu law and culture.

stamp.alt: Stamp illustration of the great red monolith of Uluru with desert scrub under a glowing sky.

destinations.name: Milford Sound
destinations.summary: A fiord of sheer peaks and waterfalls on New Zealand's South Island.
destinations.story: Milford Sound, or Piopiotahi in te reo Māori, is a fiord in Fiordland National Park. Mitre Peak rises steeply from the water, and waterfalls swell after heavy rain. The area receives very high rainfall, so a misty day is part of the experience.

stamp.alt: Stamp illustration of the sharp peak of Mitre Peak reflected in calm green water.

destinations.name: Whitsundays
destinations.summary: Seven kilometres of bright white silica sand in the Whitsundays.
destinations.story: Whitehaven Beach on Whitsunday Island is known for its bright white silica sand and for the swirling blues of Hill Inlet at its northern end. It lies within Whitsunday Islands National Park, off the coast of Queensland, close to the Great Barrier Reef.

stamp.alt: Stamp illustration of swirling bands of white sand and turquoise water beside small islands and palms.

destinations.name: Bora Bora
destinations.summary: A South Pacific lagoon guarded by a volcanic peak.
destinations.story: Bora Bora in French Polynesia is an island surrounded by a lagoon and barrier reef, with the volcanic peaks of Mount Otemanu and Mount Pahia at its heart. Overwater bungalows built on stilts above the shallow lagoon are a hallmark of the island.

stamp.alt: Stamp illustration of a steep volcanic peak above a turquoise lagoon with overwater bungalows.
